idea-plugin.name: Neo4j Cypher Syntax Highlighter and Formatter
idea-plugin.description:
Write Neo4j Cypher queries with full IDE support — right inside any JetBrains IDE.

Features

  • Semantic syntax highlighting — keywords, function calls, node labels, relationship types, properties, and parameters each get their own color category, fully customizable under Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → Cypher.
  • Code completion — all Cypher keywords and the complete Neo4j 5.x built-in function catalog.
  • Auto-formatter — consistent indentation and automatic keyword uppercasing on Code → Reformat Code (Ctrl+Alt+L / ⌘⌥L).
  • Code folding — collapse MATCH, WHERE, WITH, and other clause blocks to reduce visual noise in long queries.
  • Structure view — top-level Cypher clauses listed in the Structure panel for quick navigation.
  • Brace matching — instant visual pairing of (), [], and {}.
  • Comment toggling — Ctrl+/ for line comments (//), Ctrl+Shift+/ for block comments (/* */).
  • Error detection — unclosed delimiters highlighted inline.

Supported file types

Activates automatically for .cyp and .cypher files.

Requirements

Any JetBrains IDE 2025.1 or newer.
